{{Quote|The micro-grenade launcher is a devastating weapon, but make sure that you replace the magnetic rings that propel the explosive. During a firefight on Maro Della, the rings&mdash;which had degraded after repeated use&mdash;failed and jammed a grenade in the barrel. I only had a couple of seconds to toss the gun before the grenade detonated.|Hyannis, ''Gundark's Gear Datalog''|<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
'''Hyannis''' was an individual alive by the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[3 ABY/Legends|38:4:1:02]]. Hyannis was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]], and left a comment on the entry for the [[Model MGL-1]] [[Micro-grenade launcher/Legends|micro-grenade launcher]].<ref name="Gundark" />
